scripts.lint: pnpm lint:ts && pnpm lint:rust && pnpm lint:py
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.lint:py: uv run --directory services/research-engine ruff check && uv run --directory services/research-engine ruff format --check
scripts.format: prettier --write . && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && uv run --directory services/research-engine ruff format
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r typecheck && uv run --directory services/research-engine mypy
scripts.test: pnpm test:py && pnpm test:ts && pnpm test:rust
scripts.contracts: uv run --directory services/research-engine python -m research_engine.export_contracts && pnpm --filter @lead/shared-types generate
scripts.contracts:check: uv run --directory services/research-engine python -m research_engine.export_contracts --check && pnpm --filter @lead/shared-types check
scripts.check: pnpm contracts:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
